gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-006 concerns using an unreflected next-step network value in reflected regression labels. It does not identify the missing increasing-time preprocessing pass or unavailable base paths in the decreasing-time pseudocode.

gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both identify the unsupported removal of finite-sample target fluctuations from the error recursion: conditional or centered Monte Carlo label variance must be retained and propagated, rather than treating the target difference as residual-only.
gold_decisions.uncovered_gold_detail: No substantive gold concern is left unrecognised; ISSUE-003 demonstrates the variance omission through the bootstrapped-label conditional-variance term rather than explicitly deriving the separate 1/K and 1/(Kh) orders.
